about.description:
Langflow is a modular visual framework designed for building scalable RAG and
multi-agent setups. This recipe structures the codebase into dedicated core outputs
while placing downstream integration plugins under strict constraint gates.
about.summary: Core execution and UI service runtime engines for Langflow

tests.script: python -c "from passlib.context import CryptContext; ctx = CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt'], deprecated='auto'); h = ctx.hash('bcrypt-pin-loosen-roundtrip'); assert ctx.verify('bcrypt-pin-loosen-roundtrip', h), 'bcrypt verify failed'; import bcrypt as _b; _ver = getattr(_b, '__version__', '0.0'); _tup = tuple(int(x) for x in _ver.split('.')[:2]); assert _tup >= (4, 1), f'expected resolved bcrypt >=4.1 to prove the loosened pin actually took effect, got {_ver}'; print('bcrypt version:', _ver); print('bcrypt hash/verify OK')"

python -c "import sys; import langflow; import markitdown; import onnxruntime as ort; from magika import Magika; ver = ort.__version__; parts = [int(x) for x in ver.split('.')[:3]]; parts += [0] * (3 - len(parts)); assert not (sys.version_info >= (3, 14) and tuple(parts) < (1, 25, 1)), f'py3.14 needs onnxruntime >=1.25.1, got {ver}'; r = Magika().identify_bytes(b'hello py314 onnxruntime'); assert r.output.label; print('onnxruntime version:', ver); print('langflow + markitdown/magika/onnxruntime OK:', r.output.label)"

name: lfx
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.11.4"
  sdk_version: "0.3.3"
  # lfx-* extension bundles are versioned independently of langflow itself
  # (src/bundles/<name>/pyproject.toml), so each gets its own context pin.
  duckduckgo_version: "0.1.2"
  arxiv_version: "0.1.2"
  ibm_version: "0.1.2"
  docling_version: "0.1.3"

recipe:
  name: langflow-suite
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e33b205553cb27800c26fcf6826e80fdb88b764c3f007f28e2d3ab989b1a1cf0
  # Langflow bundles a very large number of third-party integrations (IBM watsonx,
  # MongoDB, ClickHouse, etc.) as hard dependencies by default. These patches strip
  # out everything that isn't needed to import and run langflow. Nobody uses all of
  # these integrations at once, so keeping them as hard deps would force every user
  # to install a large set of heavy libraries/ecosystems they will likely never touch,
  # which only grows the install footprint and blast radius for no benefit.
  patches:
    - patches/0001-strip-integration-deps.patch
    - patches/0002-lean-umbrella-deps.patch
    - patches/0003-strip-ibm-db-dep.patch
    # Loosens src/backend/base/pyproject.toml's exact bcrypt==4.0.1 pin to
    # >=4.0.1,<5 to match the loosened langflow-base run: dep below (G26:
    # pip_check reads the WHEEL's dist-info METADATA, which still bakes in
    # upstream's exact pin unless the source pyproject is patched too).
    - patches/0004-loosen-bcrypt-pin.patch
    # Loosens src/backend/base/pyproject.toml's marker-split onnxruntime deps to
    # >=1.20 to match the loosened langflow-base run: dep below (G26: pip_check
    # reads the WHEEL's dist-info METADATA, which still bakes in upstream's
    # per-interpreter marker split unless the source pyproject is patched too).
    - patches/0005-loosen-onnxruntime-pin.patch

build:
  number: 2

outputs:
  - package:
      name: langflow-sdk
      version: ${{ sdk_version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install src/sdk -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - httpx
        - h2
        - pydantic-settings >=2.10.1
        - pydantic >=2.0.0
        - tomli >=2.2.1
        - typing_extensions >=4.14.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - langflow_sdk
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: lfx
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install src/lfx -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - langchain-core >=1.2.28,<2.0.0
        - pandas >=2.0.0,<3.0.0
        - pydantic >=2.0.0,<3.0.0
        - pillow >=11.1.0,<13.0.0
        - openpyxl >=3.1.5,<4.0.0
        - fastapi >=0.135.0,<1.0.0
        - uvicorn >=0.34.3,<1.0.0
        - if: not win
          then:
            - gunicorn >=22.0
            - a2wsgi >=1.10.0
        - typer >=0.16.0,<1.0.0
        - platformdirs >=4.3.8,<5.0.0
        - aiofiles >=24.1.0,<25.0.0
        - typing_extensions >=4.14.0,<5.0.0
        - python-dotenv >=1.0.0,<2.0.0
        - rich >=13.0.0,<14.0.0
        - httpx >=0.24.0,<1.0.0
        - aiofile >=3.8.0,<4.0.0
        - json-repair >=0.30.3,<1.0.0
        - docstring_parser >=0.16,<1.0.0
        - networkx >=3.4.2,<4.0.0
        - nanoid >=2.0.0,<3.0.0
        - cachetools >=6.0.0
        - emoji >=2.14.1,<3.0.0
        - chardet >=7.3.0
        - defusedxml >=0.7.1,<1.0.0
        - passlib >=1.7.4,<2.0.0
        - pydantic-settings >=2.10.1,<3.0.0
        - toml >=0.10.2,<1.0.0
        - tomli >=2.2.1,<3.0.0
        - pyyaml >=6.0.0,<7.0.0
        - orjson >=3.11.6,<4.0.0
        - asyncer >=0.0.8,<1.0.0
        - structlog >=25.4.0,<26.0.0
        - loguru >=0.7.3,<1.0.0
        - langchain >=1.3.0,<1.4.0
        - langchain-classic >=1.0.7,<1.1.0
        - validators >=0.34.0,<1.0.0
        - filelock >=3.20.1,<4.0.0
        - pypdf >=6.10.0,<7.0.0
        - cryptography >=48.0.1
        - pyjwt >=2.10.0,<3.0.0
        - ag-ui-protocol >=0.1.10
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('langflow-sdk', exact=True) }}
        - markitdown >=0.1.4,<2.0.0
        - setuptools >=83.0.0,<84.0.0
        - wheel >=0.46.2,<1.0.0
        - mcp >=1.17.0,<2.0.0
        - psutil >=5.9.0,<8.0.0
        - beautifulsoup4 >=4.12.3,<5.0.0
      run_constraints:
        - magika >=0.6.1,!=0.6.3,<0.7.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lfx
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*

  - package:
      name: lfx-duckduckgo
      version: ${{ duckduckgo_version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install src/bundles/duckduckgo -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lfx', exact=True) }}
        - langchain-community >=0.4.1,<1.0.0
        - ddgs >=9.0.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lfx_duckduckgo
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*

  - package:
      name: lfx-arxiv
      version: ${{ arxiv_version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install src/bundles/arxiv -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lfx', exact=True) }}
        - defusedxml >=0.7.1,<1.0.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lfx_arxiv
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*

  - package:
      name: lfx-ibm
      version: ${{ ibm_version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install src/bundles/ibm -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lfx', exact=True) }}
        - langchain-community >=0.4.1,<1.0.0
        - ibm-watsonx-ai >=1.3.1,<2.0.0
        - langchain-ibm >=1.1.0,<1.2.0
      run_constraints:
        # ibm_db (the Db2 Vector Store client) has no upstream build for
        # linux-aarch64, and this is a noarch package built once -- a
        # platform selector here wouldn't reflect the installer's actual
        # platform. Kept as a constraint rather than a hard dep so
        # linux-aarch64 users can still install lfx-ibm; Db2VectorStore
        # needs ibm_db installed separately on platforms that support it.
        # patches/0003-strip-ibm-db-dep.patch drops ibm-db from the
        # bundle's own pyproject.toml so pip_check doesn't flag it as an
        # unmet hard requirement.
        - ibm_db >=3.2.9,<4.0.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lfx_ibm
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*

  - package:
      name: lfx-docling
      version: ${{ docling_version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install src/bundles/docling -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lfx', exact=True) }}
        - httpx >=0.28.1,<1.0.0
        - docling-core >=2.36.1,<3.0.0
      run_constraints:
        # The upstream `local`/`chunking`/`image-description` extras pull a
        # heavy OCR/torch stack that users who only exchange DoclingDocument
        # objects with a remote converter don't need, so they're kept as
        # constraints rather than hard deps. rapidocr-onnxruntime, ocrmac,
        # and langchain-docling aren't currently packaged on conda-forge --
        # install those with pip if the full local extra is needed.
        - docling >=2.36.1,<3.0.0
        - tesserocr >=2.8.0
        - pytorch >=2.6.0
        - torchvision >=0.21.0
        - tiktoken >=0.7.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lfx_docling
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*

  - package:
      name: langflow-base
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        # accessibility-checker (a frontend devDependency) pulls in puppeteer, whose
        # postinstall tries to download a Chrome binary. That download fails in the
        # build sandbox, and the binary is unused by `npm run build` anyway.
        - if: win
          then: |
            set PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true
            call npm --prefix src/frontend ci
            if errorlevel 1 exit 1
            call npm --prefix src/frontend run build
            if errorlevel 1 exit 1
            call npx --yes license-checker --production --start src/frontend --customPath %RECIPE_DIR%\license-checker-format.json --json --out src/frontend/third-party-licenses.json
            if errorlevel 1 exit 1
          else: |
            set -ex
            export PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true
            npm --prefix src/frontend ci
            npm --prefix src/frontend run build
            npx --yes license-checker --production --start src/frontend --customPath "$RECIPE_DIR/license-checker-format.json" --json --out src/frontend/third-party-licenses.json
        # The frontend build bundles code from hundreds of third-party npm packages into
        # langflow/frontend/assets/*.js. license-checker collects each package's own license
        # text (via --customPath) into a single JSON disclaimer, which is shipped as this
        # output's license_file below alongside Langflow's own LICENSE.
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -c "import shutil; d='src/backend/base/langflow/frontend'; shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True); shutil.copytree('src/frontend/build', d)"
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install src/backend/base -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      build:
        - nodejs >=20.19.0
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lfx', exact=True) }}
        - fastapi >=0.135.0,<1.0.0
        - slowapi >=0.1.9,<1.0.0
        - httpx >=0.27,<1.0.0
        - aiofile >=3.9.0,<4.0.0
        - uvicorn >=0.30.0,<1.0.0
        - langchain >=1.3.0,<1.4.0
        - langchain-community >=0.4.1,<0.5.0
        - langchain-weaviate >=0.0.6
        - langchain-core >=1.3.3,<2.0.0
        - langchainhub >=0.1.15,<0.2.0
        - loguru >=0.7.1,<1.0.0
        - structlog >=25.4.0,<26.0.0
        - rich >=13.7.0,<14.0.0
        - langchain-experimental >=0.4.1,<0.5.0
        - sqlmodel >=0.0.37,<0.1.0
        - pydantic >=2.13.0,<3.0.0
        - pydantic-settings >=2.2.0,<3.0.0
        - email-validator >=2.0.0
        - typer >=0.13.0,<1.0.0
        - cachetools >=6.0.0
        - platformdirs >=4.2.0,<5.0.0
        - python-multipart >=0.0.12,<1.0.0
        - orjson >=3.11.6,<4.0.0
        - alembic >=1.13.0,<2.0.0
        - passlib >=1.7.4,<2.0.0
        # Loosened from an exact ==4.0.1 pin (upstream PR #1266): ==4.0.1 has no
        # py3.14 (cp314) conda-forge build. <5 avoids adopting bcrypt's next major.
        - bcrypt >=4.0.1,<5
        - pillow >=12.1.1,<13.0.0
        - docstring_parser >=0.16,<1.0.0
        - pyjwt >=2.12.1
        - pandas >=2.2.3
        - multiprocess >=0.70.14,<1.0.0
        - python-docx >=1.1.0,<2.0.0
        - nest-asyncio >=1.6.0,<2.0.0
        - emoji >=2.12.0,<3.0.0
        - cryptography >=48.0.1
        - asyncer >=0.0.5,<1.0.0
        - pyperclip >=1.8.2,<2.0.0
        - uncurl >=0.0.11,<1.0.0
        - sentry-sdk >=2.5.1,<3.0.0
        - chardet >=7.3.0
        - firecrawl >=1.0.16,<2.0.0
        - opentelemetry-api >=1.30.0,<2.0.0
        - opentelemetry-sdk >=1.30.0,<2.0.0
        - opentelemetry-exporter-prometheus >=0.50b0,<1.0.0
        - opentelemetry-exporter-otlp >=1.30.0,<2.0.0
        - opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi >=0.50b0,<1.0.0
        - opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests >=0.50b0,<1.0.0
        - opentelemetry-instrumentation-urllib3 >=0.50b0,<1.0.0
        - prometheus_client >=0.20.0,<1.0.0
        - aiofiles >=24.1.0,<25.0.0
        - pip >=26.0.0,<27.0.0
        - setuptools >=83.0.0,<84.0.0
        - nanoid >=2.0.0,<3.0.0
        - filelock >=3.20.1,<4.0.0
        - grandalf >=0.8.0,<1.0.0
        - assemblyai >=0.33.0,<1.0.0
        - fastapi-pagination >=0.13.1,<1.0.0
        - defusedxml >=0.7.1,<1.0.0
        - pypdf >=6.10.0,<7.0.0
        - validators >=0.34.0,<1.0.0
        - networkx >=3.4.2,<4.0.0
        - json-repair >=0.30.3,<1.0.0
        - mcp >=1.28.0,<2.0.0
        - a2a-sdk >=1.1.0,<2.0.0
        - ag-ui-protocol ==0.1.18
        - aiosqlite >=0.20.0,<1.0.0
        - greenlet >=3.1.1,<4.0.0
        - jsonquerylang >=1.1.1,<2.0.0
        - sqlalchemy >=2.0.38,<3.0.0
        - scipy >=1.15.2,<2.0.0
        - jaraco.context >=6.1.0
        - wheel >=0.46.2,<1.0.0
        # Loosened from >=1.20,<1.24 — noarch: python collapses upstream's
        # marker split and silently drops cp314 (first cp314 build is 1.25.1).
        - onnxruntime >=1.20  # TODO: tighten once upstream drops the py<3.14 cap
        - dynaconf >=3.2.13,<4.0.0
        - pyasn1 >=0.6.3,<0.7.0
        - langgraph-checkpoint >4.0.0,<5.0.0
        - transformers >=5.6.0,<6.0.0
      run_constraints:
        - gunicorn >=25.3.0,<27.0.0
        - langchain-mongodb >=0.11.0
        - langchain-perplexity >=1.0.0,<2.0.0
        - langchain-qdrant >=1.0.0,<2.0.0
        - langchain-chroma >=0.2.6,<2.0.0

        - clickhouse-connect ==0.7.19

        - jq >=1.7.0,<2.0.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - langflow
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
      - python:
          imports:
            - langflow
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - 3.14.*
      - package_contents:
          site_packages:
            - langflow/frontend/index.html
            - langflow/frontend/assets/*.js
      - script:
          - python -c "from passlib.context import CryptContext; ctx = CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt'], deprecated='auto'); h = ctx.hash('bcrypt-pin-loosen-roundtrip'); assert ctx.verify('bcrypt-pin-loosen-roundtrip', h), 'bcrypt verify failed'; import bcrypt as _b; _ver = getattr(_b, '__version__', '0.0'); _tup = tuple(int(x) for x in _ver.split('.')[:2]); assert _tup >= (4, 1), f'expected resolved bcrypt >=4.1 to prove the loosened pin actually took effect, got {_ver}'; print('bcrypt version:', _ver); print('bcrypt hash/verify OK')"

          run:
            - python 3.14.*
      - script:
          - python -c "import sys; import langflow; import markitdown; import onnxruntime as ort; from magika import Magika; ver = ort.__version__; parts = [int(x) for x in ver.split('.')[:3]]; parts += [0] * (3 - len(parts)); assert not (sys.version_info >= (3, 14) and tuple(parts) < (1, 25, 1)), f'py3.14 needs onnxruntime >=1.25.1, got {ver}'; r = Magika().identify_bytes(b'hello py314 onnxruntime'); assert r.output.label; print('onnxruntime version:', ver); print('langflow + markitdown/magika/onnxruntime OK:', r.output.label)"

          run:
            - python 3.14.*
            - markitdown >=0.1.4
            - magika >=0.6.1,!=0.6.3,<0.7.0

      license_file:

      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('langflow-base', exact=True) }}
      run_constraints:
        - fastmcp >=3.2.0
        - lark ==1.2.2
        - sseclient-py ==1.8.0
        - litellm >=1.85.1,<2.0.0
        - openai >=1.68.2,<3.0.0
        - langchain-anthropic >=1.4.6,<1.5.0
        - langchain-aws >=1.1.0,<1.2.0
        - langchain-chroma >=0.2.6,<2.0.0

tests.script: python -c "from passlib.context import CryptContext; ctx = CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt'], deprecated='auto'); h = ctx.hash('bcrypt-pin-loosen-roundtrip'); assert ctx.verify('bcrypt-pin-loosen-roundtrip', h), 'bcrypt verify failed'; import bcrypt as _b; _ver = getattr(_b, '__version__', '0.0'); _tup = tuple(int(x) for x in _ver.split('.')[:2]); assert _tup >= (4, 1), f'expected resolved bcrypt >=4.1 to prove the loosened pin actually took effect, got {_ver}'; print('bcrypt version:', _ver); print('bcrypt hash/verify OK')"

python -c "import sys; import langflow; import markitdown; import onnxruntime as ort; from magika import Magika; ver = ort.__version__; parts = [int(x) for x in ver.split('.')[:3]]; parts += [0] * (3 - len(parts)); assert not (sys.version_info >= (3, 14) and tuple(parts) < (1, 25, 1)), f'py3.14 needs onnxruntime >=1.25.1, got {ver}'; r = Magika().identify_bytes(b'hello py314 onnxruntime'); assert r.output.label; print('onnxruntime version:', ver); print('langflow + markitdown/magika/onnxruntime OK:', r.output.label)"
